units.text: INT. ABANDONED BOWLING ALLEY - NIGHT
Dead neon.
Lane 6 still has pins.
A birthday banner droops: HAPPY 40TH, KEVIN.

DOT, forties, event planner, clipboard clamped to her chest, shoves a cake onto the ball return while FITZ, thirties, in a rented shark costume, trips over his own fin and takes down a rack of house shoes and OGUNLEYE, "GUNNY" to all, sixties, a retired lane mechanic with a toolbox, drops to one knee to catch the cake before it slides off, and the ball return rumbles, and the cake shoots down Lane 6 like a torpedo.
Silence.
A single pin wobbles.
Nobody saw that.
units.name: DOT

units.text: I saw it. I'm a shark. We see everything.
units.name: FITZ

units.text: That cake had eighty dollars of fondant on it.
units.name: GUNNY

units.text: Kevin arrives in ten minutes. Ten.
units.name: DOT

units.text: Fitz yanks the shark head off, sweaty, hair plastered.
I can't breathe in this thing. Why am I a shark?
units.name: FITZ

units.text: Kevin loves sharks.
units.name: DOT

units.text: Kevin loves SHARKS. Not men inside sharks.
units.name: FITZ

units.text: Gunny walks down the lane, picks up the ruined cake with both hands like an infant, and carries it back, frosting to the elbows.
I can fix it. Give me a spatula and a prayer.
units.name: GUNNY

units.text: I have neither. I have a clipboard.
units.name: DOT

units.text: An INTERCOM crackles overhead.
Attention, party in Lane 6. Your guest of honor is in the parking lot and he's on the phone with his mother.
units.name: PRU

units.text: How long?
units.name: DOT

units.text: His mother is Greek. I'd say forty minutes.
units.name: PRU

units.text: Dot exhales for the first time in an hour.
She sits on the ball return.
So we have time.
units.name: FITZ

units.text: We have time.
units.name: DOT

units.text: Then somebody hand me a spatula.
units.name: GUNNY

units.text: Fitz offers a bowling shoe.
Gunny takes it, considers it, and uses it.
For the record, the shark is good.
units.name: PRU

units.text: Fitz bows.
His fin knocks over the last pin.
